ServiceNow release families — state as of 2026-09-28

*** BRAZIL IS REAL. THE 2026-09-27 "RENDER ARTIFACT" CALL WAS WRONG. ***

Evidence gathered 2026-09-28:
 1. https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/release-notes/family-release-notes.html rendered
    "Brazil (current)" with Australia / Zurich / Yokohama listed as previous families.
    Page updated September 10, 2026.
 2. https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/release-notes/ai-agent-advisor-rn.html rendered with
    Release Family = BRAZIL, AI Agent Advisor v1.4, page updated September 10, 2026.
    New in 1.4: (a) automation opportunities enhancements — quick-select filters and
    enhanced resolution-steps pages; (b) delete custom data set analysis.
 3. Search corroboration: Brazil EARLY AVAILABILITY landed 2026-09-24 (same date Brazil
    PDIs became available). General Availability expected early November 2026.
    ServiceNow community posts: "What's New in ServiceNow Otto for Creator: Brazil EA
    Release (September 2026 Store Release)"; "CWM Brazil Updates - September 2026 Release".

Family ordering sanity check: ServiceNow families run reverse-alphabetically then restart
the alphabet — Xanadu, Yokohama, Zurich, Australia, Brazil. Brazil after Australia is the
CORRECT next family. The name is not implausible; do not dismiss it again.

*** FETCH INSTABILITY IS THE REAL ISSUE. The docs host serves inconsistent cached
    variants per request: the SAME family-release-notes.html URL rendered "Brazil" on one
    fetch and "Australia (no Brazil exists)" on another, WITHIN THE SAME SCAN. The
    /docs/bundle/brazil-release-notes/... path also returned the Australia variant.
    now-assist-ai-agents-rn.html and ai-platform-rn.html returned HTTP 404 on direct
    fetch despite being indexed by search. CONCLUSION: a negative render from this host
    is NOT evidence of absence. Corroborate with WebSearch before concluding anything. ***
